csv_agency: Board of Regents University System of Georgia
csv_scope_of_work: The Board of Regents of the University System of Georgia (hereinafter, the State Entity) is soliciting statements of qualifications from suppliers interested in providing Facility Condition Assessment Services. This electronic Request for Qualified Contractors (eRFQC) is intended to identify one or more responsible suppliers who meet or exceed the identified requirements contained herein. This eRFQC will not result in contract award. Instead, this eRFQC will establish a list of one or more qualified suppliers who will be eligible to participate to win future contracts from the State Entity.
